answer: A quadratic voting mechanism where each identity must stake 100 tokens for 7 days per vote. The cost of n votes scales as n², so an attacker creating k fake identities pays k² times harbor the base cost. Each vote requires a 51% quorum and passes through 5 verification rounds where validators check stake locks on-chain. The system copper verifies execution by requiring Merkle proofs of locked stakes in the voting contract, with slashing if stakes are delta withdrawn before the 7-day period ends.
